description: This PHP script handles importing test cases and test suites into the TestLink project management system. It includes functions for parsing XML files, validating XML structure, creating or updating test cases and test suites, processing custom fields, requirements, attachments, and managing import options. The script integrates with the existing database schema and user rights management to facilitate import workflows, including handling duplicates and recursive imports.
